有些愛，
不是從某一個特別的瞬間開始。

是在日子裡，
慢慢習慣彼此的存在。

走成了現在的我們。

KAT_孫佳暄《 家族氣味的初始 》
description:
中文
作品源自藝術家童年的氣味記憶——
土地的潮濕、養豬場的水氣、甘蔗的甜香、鐵鏽的金屬味。
回到橋頭製糖工場後，她以行走與訪談重構家族的勞動軌跡，
讓身體重新貼近土地的呼吸。
作品使用糖廠廢棄金屬進行鏽染，
時間的氧化滲入布料，形成工業遺緒的層層紋理。
鍋爐升溫後的蒸氣、黑糖與甘蔗的甜氣，
彷彿童年糖果般的香味記憶重新浮現。
最終，她描繪出 「未來糖廠記憶工程圖」——
一場慢速、溫潤、如同糖煉化般的共同生成，
讓感官重新連結生活的根，喚醒土地的氣味。
English
The work originates from the artist’s childhood scent memories—
the dampness of soil, the moisture of pig farms, the sweetness of sugarcane, and the metallic tang of rust.
Returning to the Qiaotou Sugar Factory, she retraced her family’s labor through walking and conversation, allowing her body to reconnect with the land’s breath.
Using discarded metal from the factory for rust dyeing,
the oxidation of time seeped into fabric, forming layered traces of industrial history.
Steam rising from boilers, the aroma of molasses and sugarcane—
these scents revive memories reminiscent of childhood sweets.
The result is a “Future Memory Map of the Sugar Factory”—
a slow, gentle co-creation, like sugar refining itself,
reconnecting the senses with the land and awakening its lingering fragrance.
